cases.title: Design: invoiced card keeps "Lead technician" and "Service advisor" labels
cases.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-17-n1-invoiced.png" (board 1.17) and "card-02-n1-rest.png" (board 1.2) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} has been invoiced; its card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" reading {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" reading {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} is open and not invoiced.
    For example: {Work-order-2} is S2-40002.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
cases.custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, read the labels of the four fields on the card and compare them with the picture of board 1.17.
  2. Hover over the four fields.
  3. Open {Work-order-2} and compare its Lead Technician, Service Advisor and Sales Representative labels with the picture of board 1.2.
cases.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the labels read "Lead technician" and "Service advisor" (small second word, as on an invoiced card today), then "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" with capital letters; each name sits below its label as plain text, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: nothing changes: no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x.
  • Step 3: on the open work order the labels read "Lead Technician", "Service Advisor" and "Sales Representative", as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names. On the read-only card only the Sales Representative fields read as in S1-R2 and S2-R5; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's read-only labels.”
  • S1-R2: “The field is the same field as Lead Technician and Service Advisor: the label "Sales Representative" sits inside it on the first line and the name on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, question sheet of 19 Oct 2026, Google Sheet 17Ry1BtRTPEkecBP5TlgAE0T93Ai1TQewdJ7B7WpWDBQ, tab "Questions for Chris", rows 6-43 (answered 19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 8: “8. (a) Lead technician and Service advisor stay as they are today; only the Sales Representative fields use the new labels.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.17 After invoicing: read only; 1.2 Nobody assigned, at rest (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: card-17-n1-invoiced.png, card-02-n1-rest.png.

  • Design — board 1.17 title: “1.17 After invoicing: read only”
  • Design — board 1.17 note: “Invoiced work order S2-17540 with two reps. The rows are plain text: "Sales Representative - Labor" Daniel Montoya, "Sales Representative - Parts" Becky Gonzales. Measured gaps: 16px, 16px, 16px (decision 47).” “Hovering the rows changes nothing: no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x (checked in the browser: zero buttons on the card; the hovered screenshot is identical to this one).”
  • Design — board 1.2 title: “1.2 Nobody assigned, at rest”
  • Design — board 1.2 note: “Plain text, like Lead Technician and Service Advisor: "Sales Representative", reading "Unassigned". No box and no buttons at rest.” “Measured gaps: 16px, 16px.” “Lead Technician reads blank here on first load; production does the same (board 1.0). It is not part of this project.”

cases.title: Design: a part sale row shows a dash in the labor columns
cases.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "sbr-03-b-sbr-expanded.png" (board 4.3), "sbr-10-a4-sbr-expanded-type.png" (board 4.10), "sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png" (board 4.11) and "sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png" (board 4.12) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-1} for {Customer-A} has Sales Representative {Sales-rep-A}, one part and no labor, and was invoiced today.
    For example: {Part-sale-1} is P-30001 with one part sold at $50.00.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open in that browser window, with the date range set to today and Show Unassigned on.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
cases.custom_steps:
1. Turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector and expand {Sales-rep-A}.
  2. Read {Part-sale-1}'s row in the Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin columns and compare it with the picture of board 4.10.
  3. Export the Expanded CSV and read the same row's Hrs Worked, Hrs Invoiced, Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin cells.
  4. Export the Expanded PDF and read the same cells.
cases.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Part-sale-1} shows as one row with Sales Type "Part Sales".
  • Step 2: each labor column shows a dash ("—"), as in the picture (today's report, board 4.3, shows 0.00 and $0.00 there).
  • Step 3: those cells are blank, as in the picture of board 4.11.
  • Step 4: those cells show a dash, as in the picture of board 4.12.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R9: “A part sale is one "Part Sales" row holding every dollar of the invoice.”
  • S5-R3: “The report reads every invoice as one row per representative per Sales Type: "Labor" for a work order's labor side, "Parts" for its parts side, and "Part Sales" for a part sale.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 4.3 Before: expanded; 4.10 Expanded with Sales Type; 4.11 Expanded export (CSV); 4.12 Expanded export (PDF) (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: This is the design's version, held. The PRD gives the dash rule only for a work order's Labor and Parts rows (S5-R15) and for a part sale's Shop Supplies (S5-R15a); it says nothing about a part sale row's labor columns. Today's report (board 4.3) shows 0.00 / $0.00 there; the design shows a dash and blank cells (boards 4.5, 4.10 to 4.12). Waiting on the product owner: question Q-A in DESIGN-DIVERGENCE-REGISTER.json (drafted 20 Oct 2026, not sent).

Design pictures attached to this case: sbr-03-b-sbr-expanded.png, sbr-10-a4-sbr-expanded-type.png, sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png, sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png.

  • Design — board 4.3 title: “4.3 Before: expanded”
  • Design — board 4.3 note: “Production today. One row per invoice under each rep.”
  • Design — board 4.10 title: “4.10 Expanded with Sales Type”
  • Design — board 4.10 note: “Values: Labor, Parts and Part Sales. One rep with both sides of one work order shows as one row reading "Labor, Parts" (S1-32, decision 38). S1-12: Devon "Parts" ($266.18), Elliot "Labor" ($2,186.82), shop supplies ($175.50) with Labor (decision 37).” “At 1600px wide, the columns after Parts Margin scroll under the pinned Subtotal; production behaves the same.”
  • Design — board 4.11 title: “4.11 Expanded export (CSV)”
  • Design — board 4.11 note: “Downloaded with the Sales Type column switched off on screen: the file still has Sales Type (decision 40). An empty side is a blank cell. (Shown as a spreadsheet would open it.)”
  • Design — board 4.12 title: “4.12 Expanded export (PDF)”
  • Design — board 4.12 note: “The PDF always has the Sales Type column. An empty side shows a dash. Header lines name the filters, including "Sales Type: All".”
